cards.title: Prompt & Untrusted Data Separation
cards.deterministic_analogy: SQLi parameterization: never concatenate untrusted text directly into executable instructions.
cards.secure_default: Wrap untrusted user inputs and RAG chunks inside explicit <untrusted_context> delimiters via stormcage with a strict data-only instruction.
cards.why_one_liner: Untrusted tickets, web pages, or PDFs concatenated into prompts can hijack the model into leaking data or invoking tools.

cards.title: RAG Vector Store Tenant Isolation
cards.deterministic_analogy: Row-level SQL WHERE tenant_id = $1: enforce access control in the DB query, never in prompt prose.
cards.secure_default: Filter vector similarity queries by authenticated tenant_id or user_id in the database WHERE predicate before returning chunks to the LLM.
cards.why_one_liner: Relying on prompt instructions to hide other tenants' retrieved chunks fails easily under indirect injection or summarization.
cards.code_snippet:
SELECT id, body FROM doc_chunks
WHERE tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY embedding <=> $2
LIMIT 5;

cards.title: Untrusted LLM Output Schema Validation
cards.deterministic_analogy: XSS and command injection defense: treat model responses identically to untrusted internet form input.
cards.secure_default: Parse LLM outputs against a strict typed JSON schema and allowlist before passing values into SQL, shell, HTML, or HTTP sinks.
cards.why_one_liner: Prompt-injected models can emit crafted JSON, SQL, or shell arguments that execute unintended actions in downstream handlers.
cards.code_snippet:
var req RefundArgs
r := strings.NewReader(llmOutput)
dec := json.NewDecoder(r)
dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
if err := dec.Decode(&req); err != nil { return err }

cards.title: Keyless AI SDK Credential Hygiene
cards.deterministic_analogy: Short-lived runtime env injection: keep cloud and LLM API keys out of source files and notebooks.
cards.secure_default: Inject OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and GEMINI_API_KEY via locksmith run instead of hardcoding keys in .env files or notebooks.
cards.why_one_liner: Committed or cached LLM keys incur instant billing abuse and expose private fine-tunes, files, and batch job histories.
cards.code_snippet:
# Launch dev servers and notebooks with runtime-only secrets:
locksmith run -- python app.py

cards.title: PII & Secret Egress Hygiene Before LLM Calls
cards.deterministic_analogy: Log scrubbing before third-party analytics: strip sensitive tokens before payloads leave your machine.
cards.secure_default: Run local secret and PII redaction checks (shield patterns) on dev payloads and traces before sending prompts to external model APIs.
cards.why_one_liner: Stack traces and DB dumps sent verbatim to hosted LLMs leak session tokens, customer PII, and internal credentials.

cards.title: Local Adversarial AI Regression Tests
cards.deterministic_analogy: Unit tests for auth bypasses: replay known prompt-injection payloads automatically before every PR.
cards.secure_default: Add deterministic local adversarial prompt and RAG injection fixtures and run aegisbox test --ai-safety before opening a PR.
cards.why_one_liner: Prompt tweaks silently break safety boundaries; automated local replay catches regressions in seconds without cloud dependencies.
cards.code_snippet:
# Replay local prompt-injection & tool-boundary fixtures:
aegisbox test --ai-safety ./tests/ai-safety.yaml
